status_effects.explanation: The narrator is momentarily drawn into favorable visibility within Saint-Loup's circle of friends, being showcased and implicitly praised, though the passage frames this as a strange, semi-alienating self-discovery rather than a clean social triumph.

appraisal_events.evidence: « il surveillait du coin de l'oeil s'ils produisaient chez ses amis l'effet sur lequel il avait compté... il me présentait pour la première fois l'idée qu'il avait de moi et qu'il avait dû souvent leur exprimer »
appraisal_events.explanation: In front of his friends, Saint-Loup actively showcases the narrator's remarks, revealing that he has praised him to the group in his absence; the narrator is moved and momentarily sees himself elevated in their regard, though the closing simile (seeing oneself 'in a mirror' or one's name 'in the newspaper') gives this a slightly self-alienated, ambivalent cast rather than pure triumph.
